title: A non-fraud loan charge-off credits LOAN_PORTFOLIO and merges the interest/fee/penalty receivables into ONE credit (loan 7 L19: credits 1000.00 then 143.00, debits 1000.00 / 30.00 / 113.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the FIVE-LEG journal entry a non-fraud loan CHARGE-OFF posted under the branch with NO charge-off reason, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT / product 3) at the charge-off transaction. request.charge_off_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's charge-off transaction id 19 (externalId L19, type loanTransactionType.chargeOff, fraud false): principalPortion 1000.0 -> "100000", interestPortion 30.0 -> "3000", feeChargesPortion 103.0 -> "10300", penaltyChargesPortion 10.0 -> "1000" minor units. request.charge_off_journal.fraud is the loan's observed fraud flag false. request.charge_off_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (loans 7 and 15) and the echo product-20-retrieve-one-response.json, whose account ids are equal: loanPortfolio 6, receivable interest/fee/penalty 10, chargeOffExpense 14, chargeOffFraudExpense 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20, incomeFromChargeOffFees 11, incomeFromChargeOffPenalty 11. expect.charge_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the five L19 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 48 CREDIT account 6 1000.00, JE 49 CREDIT account 10 143.00, JE 50 DEBIT account 14 1000.00, JE 51 DEBIT account 20 30.00, JE 52 DEBIT account 11 113.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charge-off credits each non-zero portion to its receivable slot, MERGING portions that share a credit account at the first slot's position, then debits each portion to its income/expense slot, MERGING portions that share a debit account at the first slot's position, every credit before every debit. The interest (30.0), fee (103.0) and penalty (10.0) receivable slots ALL map to account 10, so the observed credit is ONE leg of 143.00 at the interest position; the fee and penalty income slots BOTH map to account 11, so the observed debit is ONE leg of 113.00. A port that never merges posts EIGHT legs (four credits 100000/3000/10300/1000 and four debits 100000/3000/10300/1000), so the merge and the leg count are graded. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the fraud branch — this loan is NOT marked fraud, so a port that ignores the fraud flag posts the SAME legs here; the zero-portion skip — every portion here is > 0; and the charge-off-reason mapping — absent from the product, and the port REFUSES it. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
